import json,re,collections
p='.ai/task/batch-033cd11c8b1b44140e48-surface-001/SURFACE-SCREEN-ENVELOPE-lane-001-3.json'
e=json.load(open(p))['payload']['entries']

 print('ENTRY',i)
 for k in ('source','target'):
  s=x[k]
  t=re.findall(r'#\{[^}]+\}|#[A-Z_]+#|@[A-Za-z_]+@',s)
  print(k,'newlines',s.count('\n'),'paragraphs',len(s.split('\n\n')),'tokens',len(t),collections.Counter(t))
 print('token-sequence-equal',re.findall(r'#\{[^}]+\}|#[A-Z_]+#|@[A-Za-z_]+@',x['source'])==re.findall(r'#\{[^}]+\}|#[A-Z_]+#|@[A-Za-z_]+@',x['target']))
